products.title: Leg Pummeling Mastery by Mikey Musumeci
products.body:
Master The Subtle Art Of Leg Pummeling With World Champion Phenom Mikey Musumeci And Optimize Your Lower Body Grappling Game To Set Up High Percentage No-Gi Offense - Including Leg Entanglements & Back Attacks!

  • Successful leg pummeling will level up your grappling from every position, especially Mikey’s specialty - the double pull
  • Mikey Musumeci is a multiple-time IBJJF world champion in the gi who is now transitioning to no-gi grappling with incredible results
  • Pummel with your lower body and secure great positions, including the berimbolo, leg drag, honey hole, and more
  • Use the honey hole position to submit, pass, and take the back with Mikey’s step-by-step method for leg pummeling from one dominant position to another

This Six Part Series Is Packed With Details From One Of The Best Grapplers On Earth, Including How He Troubleshoots All The Common And Tricky Defenses!

 

Check out a free sample:

What Will You Learn?

Join Mikey Musumeci as he brings you through a whole new world of systematic leg pummeling, giving you the tools and skills you need to dominate the lower body exchanges and keep control of the fight. From double seated position, learn how leg pummeling can help you achieve dominant positions like the crab ride, leg drag, honey hole, and more with Mikey’s detailed instruction.

With six volumes packed full of detail, you’ll learn why leg pummeling is so important and why it can be the key to unlocking a new level of skill in your game. Use these lessons to start pummeling your way into great positions like the berimbolo, honey hole, and more, all of which are Mikey specialties.

Including just how to do these moves, learn how and when to use each or any of them, and the best ways to use them all together. Mikey shows you everything you will need, including how he troubleshoots the common defenses and how grapplers of any level, age, or athletic past can use these skills for a huge improvement in their BJJ.

products.title: The Mikey Lock by Mikey Musumeci
products.body:
Be The First In Your Gym To Learn This Leg Locking System That Black Belt World Champion Mikey Musumeci Calls “Unstoppable” - The New Innovated Mikey Lock, The Modern Heel Hooking System That Mikey Created Himself

  • This 4-part series shows you all the leg locking system that Mikey has invented, with concepts, finishes, entries, and more!
  • Learn what sets the Mikey Lock apart from the standard heel hook and how you can use this new style to overcome traditional defenses.
  • Mikey has an eight step system that grapplers of all levels can use to simplify and improve their leg locking game.
  • Mikey recently debuted The Mikey Lock at Who’s Number One, and now you can study this move and get on the trend early.
  • Attack from common guards like K guard, knee shield, and reverse de la riva with MIkey’s techniques for entering into the legs                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              

Attack From Common Guards Like K Guard, Knee Shield, And Reverse De La Riva With MIkey’s Techniques For Entering Into The Legs!


 

What Will You Learn?

Dive into the next generation of heel hooks with black belt world champion Mikey Musumeci’s “Mikey Lock”, shown here for the first time ever. This modified 50/50 heel hook system can help grapplers of all levels attack below the waist and get submissions against traditional defenses using these modern concepts and innovations.

This 4-part series breaks down the Mikey Lock in full, including entries, finishes, counters to their defenses, and more. Even with no leg locking ability coming in, you’ll be able to simplify an attack leg locks with more consistent success and technique than ever, with Mikey’s tips for success from guard.

Enter into the best leg locking positions possible from knee shield, reverse de la riva, and k guard, with options that will let you stay on offense regardless of the top player’s offense. One you are into the legs, secure the best positions with Mikey’s eight steps for submission success and create the strongest breaks possible.

products.title: K Guard and Matrix System: Attacking The Legs From The Knees Part 1 by Mikey Musumeci
products.body:
Finally Understand The Secrets To The Matrix Back Take And Learn The K Guard System That Makes Taking The Back Easier Than Ever With World Champion Mikey Musumeci’s Guide To This Modern And Effective Position

  • Use the k guard to create a dangerous open guard that can attack upper or lower body with systematic combinations
  • Use K guard to off balance and attack with Mikey’s multiple setups, off balances, back takes, and more
  • Mikey Musumeci is a multiple-time world champion and the most successful American black belt competitor ever, known for his technical wizardy and open guard skill
  • Use the matrix system to attack the back position in new and creative ways as Mikey explains how to use the right hooks, angles, and leverage to make it work
  • Combine the matrix with the baby bolo, twister hooks, and more as you move step-by-step through this simple system for the back take


Finally Understand The Secrets To The Matrix Back Take And Learn The K Guard System That Makes Taking The Back Easier Than Ever With World Champion Mikey Musumeci’s Guide To This Modern And Effective Position

Check out a free sample:

What Will You Learn?

﻿﻿Work from your back in innovative and effective system as Mikey Musumeci shows you his signature k guard and matrix back takes that he breaks down in complete detail. Now anyone can use these powerful positions to become more effective and technical off their back as they attack the upper body, lower body, and back in a unified game plan.

The K guard is a position that gives you attacks to upper or lower body, with strong options for off balancing and controlling as you scoop the legs and pummel for better positions with your legs and arms. Now you can learn how to get there, and how to win once you have it, with Mikey’s help.

Mikey Musumeci is the most successful American black belt competitor in Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu, winning multiple world championships and competing at an elite level his entire career. He has been super effective with his back takes and systematic approaches to guard positions, which you can now benefit from on this 8-volume series.

The matrix back take is a system that Mikey has been perfecting since he was a colored belt, and now uses as good as any competitor today. Use this position to get the back, as you get your hooks and secure the most dominant position in Brazilian jiu-jitsu.

So What Does It All Cost?

Deconstruct The Guard With Black Belt Technical Savant Mikey Musumeci’s Guide On How To Pass BJJ’s Most Troublesome Open Guards With Effective Understanding Of The Frames & How To Beat Them

  • Mikey Musumeci is one of the greatest grapplers of his generation, with wins in the black belt world finals using these same techniques!
  • Mikey explains how to use inside position & counter-pummeling to beat spider guard, lasso guard, collar sleeve guard, and much more
  • Explore multiple variations of passing that Mikey explains with step-by-step analysis, including some of grappling’s most high percentage passes
  • Let one of BJJ’s most accomplished guard players explain to you how to totally shut down the effective open guard and use frames from top for maximum effect
